description: This Java source file defines the class FilterThingPredicateVisitor, which implements the FilterFieldExpressionVisitor interface for Java Predicates over Thing objects. It provides methods to create predicates based on different parts of a Thing's attributes and features, by applying a provided function to specific string paths or field names.

classes.name: FilterThingPredicateVisitor
classes.description: A final class implementing FilterFieldExpressionVisitor for generating Predicates over Thing objects based on filter expressions.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Static method that creates a Predicate<Thing> from a FilterFieldExpression and a function to generate predicates based on string keys.

methods.name: visitAttribute
methods.description: Creates a predicate for a Thing attribute identified by the key.

methods.name: visitFeatureIdProperty
methods.description: Creates a predicate for a feature's property identified by featureId and property name.

methods.name: visitSimple
methods.description: Creates a predicate based on a simple field name.
